sourceNote: Catalog entries were derived from the BlazerGames repository index and on-disk game directories, plus self-hosted NettleWeb HTML5 games (folders prefixed nw-). Only games with local files in this repository are listed (self-hosted only, per project direction); external CDN entries from NettleWeb/Interstellar/GameMonetize were removed. Flash and DOS entries from the NettleWeb repository were never included: they live inside a 4.4 GB chunk archive that is not practical to self-host. Plus 85 open-source HTML5 games imported from GitHub repositories (ids prefixed oss-) under permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, CC0, GPL, MPL); upstream LICENSE files are included in each game folder.

verification.entryPoint: All local entry points verified on disk by scripts/verify-catalog.js. External (nwx-) entries point at third-party servers and are validated as URL format only.
verification.manual: Not every game has been manually played end-to-end. Playability beyond page load is not guaranteed; see README.
verification.thumbnails: Thumbnail files were copied verbatim from the source repository images directory and matched to games by filename. The 82 NettleWeb folders, 1v1.LOL and 2048 use images sourced from the NettleWeb repository (github.com/BlueDonuts/unblocked-games) d/ image library, matched by title via scripts/fetch-thumbnails.mjs. Tuff Client uses a generated SVG card.
